BUDGET = {"role-cto": 6000, "role-engineer": 3500, "role-lead": 8000, "role-product-spec": 3500,
          "role-research": 3500, "role-reviewer": 3500, "role-test-designer": 3500}
full = len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == "full"
for stem, budget in BUDGET.items():
    raw = (ROOT / f"{stem}.md").read_bytes()
    text = raw.decode("utf-8")
    size = len(s.prose(s.body(stem)))
    digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    print(stem, "prose", size, "budget", budget, "sha256", digest if full else digest[:12])
